acceptedAnswer.text: While it is possible for a DIY enthusiast to install a lever style kitchen faucet, hiring a professional in areas like the Bay Area, including Pacifica or Daly City, is often recommended. Professionals have the right tools, experience, and knowledge to ensure proper installation, prevent leaks, and address any unexpected plumbing issues that may arise. Incorrect installation can lead to costly water damage or ongoing problems. For a seamless and worry-free experience, especially if you're not confident in your plumbing skills, a contractor is the best choice.
